reviewScope: Read-only source review; no archive or retirement run

findings.finding: The lock pathname includes both attempt directory and phase, so archive/retire or different attempts on one physical source do not exclude one another. active_users is a bounded observation and cannot replace that lock.
findings.requiredClosure: Acquire one stable per-source or one global custody lock before phase-directory creation; hold it through terminal command cleanup and receipt persistence.

findings.location: git subprocess.run timeout and retirement worktree-remove call
findings.finding: The bounded subprocess is the runuser wrapper. Its timeout guarantees termination/reaping only for that direct child, not that the actual destructive Git process and descendants have stopped. A mutation can outlive a failed phase and released lock.
findings.requiredClosure: Guarantee the actual mutation process/owned process group has terminated and been reaped before writing terminal failure or releasing custody; retain first failure and lifecycle outcome. Reuse a reviewed scoped cleanup boundary where applicable.

reviewedWithoutAdditionalBlocker: Clean and untracked checks plus physical ignored-file rejection

Full archive members verified without extraction

Source-archive reserve is distinct from build admission
limits: No actual process or archive execution performed
